status: Source-checked proposals only; no scientific approval or training labels

sources.finding: Full paper recovered; separate solution and soil protocols; graphical responses are not digitized.
Isolation of salicylic acid and coumarin from Melilotus officinalis; spectral descriptions. Reported salicylic melting point needs independent chemistry review.
Carvacrol, thymol and p-cymene identified in commercial oregano oil; isolated pure-compound characterization is not supplied.

sources.locator: Author abstract; original article pp.921 onward
sources.finding: GC-MS clove eugenol and oregano carvacrol/p-cymene. Full methods and source-standard identity pending.
trans-Cinnamic acid among ten root-exudate compounds characterized by proton/carbon NMR; full spectra pending.
Bioassay-guided isolation from Piper longum fruits; complements isolation methods in Dayan 2015.
Methods specify 10 mg/mL; table headings specify 20 mg/mL. Preserve dose conflict; injury bands are not exact percentage values.
3-Phenylpropionic acid isolated from terrestrial Streptomycetes and characterized by IR/MS/proton/carbon NMR; microbial origin, not proof of plant origin.
2-Hydroxyphenylacetic acid reported isolated from Actinomycetospora strain CA287887; full source identity confirmation pending. Para-isomer isolation papers do not support this ortho isomer.
Primary isolation lead naming 2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid; requires source-structure and spectral consistency review.
Juglans nigra chemical characterization; juglone annotation reported. Full isolation/standard identity evidence still to be checked.
3-Phenylpropionic acid isolation and benzoic acid chromatographic identification in rumen fluid; natural biological occurrence, not plant-specific origin.

sources.locator: Chericoni et al., J Agric Food Chem 53:4762–4765; primary lead cited by Muñoz reference 48
sources.finding: Cinnamomum zeylanicum essential-oil study; exact trans-cinnamaldehyde characterization not verified. DOI/name locator must be confirmed.

Coumarin.reason: Named isolated compound 4 with MS/NMR characterization; final source-structure review pending.

trans-Cinnamic acid.reason: Primary NMR-characterized root-exudate isolation reported; full spectra pending.

2-Hydroxyphenylacetic acid.reason: Exact ortho-isomer primary isolation lead; reject para-isomer substitutions; full text/access pending.

3-Phenylpropionic acid.reason: Microbial/rumen isolation and spectroscopic characterization reported; source structure pending.

Salicylic acid.reason: Named isolated compound 3 and proton NMR; reported melting-point inconsistency requires independent confirmation.

2,4-Dihydroxybenzoic acid.reason: Primary compound-5 lead found; regiochemical/spectral consistency not yet adjudicated.

Benzoic acid.reason: Primary chromatographic occurrence in rumen fluid; exact standard confirmation pending.

Sarmentine.reason: Primary isolation from long pepper; source (2E,4E) structure-to-key review pending.

Thymol.reason: Primary GC-MS occurrence in oregano oil; isolated-compound identity confirmation pending.

Eugenol.reason: Primary GC-MS clove constituent; source methods/identity confirmation pending.

p-Cymene.reason: Primary GC-MS oil constituent; positional isomer and standard confirmation pending.

PROPOSED-T2024-UPV-4WAT-BASE-v1.scope: UPV mixed-weed trial, four-week coverage, named base-dose formulations. Author good/excellent-control class => active proposal; no-good-control class => low_response proposal. Different doses/sites/formulations are not pooled.

PROPOSED-D2015-PIGWEED-7DAY-v1.scope: Pigweed seven-day injury bands. All decisions unknown until the 10 versus 20 mg/mL source dose conflict and controls/replication are resolved.
